data.one_liner: Register custom URL protocol handlers across supported platforms.
data.what_it_does: A unified library to register and unregister custom URL protocol handlers. It is primarily designed for desktop platforms requiring extra programmatic registration of URL handlers.
use_when: You need to register custom URL protocols programmatically on Windows
You are building a Flutter desktop application that handles deep links or custom schemes
avoid_when: You need instructions or support for Android, iOS, or macOS
You need Linux support, which is currently coming soon
strengths: Provides a unified library approach for custom URL protocol registration
Simple imperative API with registerProtocolHandler and unregisterProtocolHandler
weaknesses: Support for mobile platforms and Linux is currently missing or listed as a TODO
Limited documentation beyond basic Windows usage
